seed_protocol.base_seed_mapping: The single base seed initializes the NumPy Generator used for the hidden parameter perturbation; the probe schedule remains fixed.
seed_protocol.determinism_scope: The exact public inverse-problem config is deterministic under the pinned runtime and is identified by the evaluator-emitted case_digest; the hidden parameter vector is not hashed or exposed.
seed_protocol.case_identity: SHA-256 of canonical JSON with sorted keys, compact separators, and ndarray/scalar normalization over the exact public config; functional stdout emits the full case_digest and protocol_seed in one structured orbit_q_case_identity JSON line.
seed_protocol.pinned_numpy_note: The target image pins NumPy 2.2.6; QR-derived public observations can drift across numerical runtimes, so trial manifests must bind the image/runtime and case_digest rather than seed alone.
